receipt.public_excerpt: Using conventional methods (e.g., Cross-Entropy loss, or simple fine-tuning, etc.) will result in the poor performance of the tail classes.

evidence_items.explanation: The contemporary synthesis documents poor learning of rare classes and substantial limitations in conventional deep-learning methods. It also reviews mitigation methods, supporting a serious practical problem without implying that every method fails.

receipt.public_excerpt: Experiments on long-tailed CIFAR, ImageNet, Places, and iNaturalist 2018 manifest the new state-of-the-art for long-tailed recognition.

evidence_items.explanation: PaCo demonstrates progress on several long-tailed benchmarks using changes within deep learning. This qualifies any stronger interpretation that the problem had no useful mitigation, but does not show it was generally solved in 2022.

unresolved_gaps: The strongest evidence concerns visual recognition; it does not quantify severity across every popular AI application.
